articles.title: Israeli strikes and gunfire in Gaza kill 5 people, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Hospital authorities in Gaza say Israeli strikes and gunfire have killed five people. Houthi officials say overnight strikes in Yemen also killed at least one person and wounded nine others in Sanaa. Meanwhile, Iranian state television broadcast a video of an underground missile facility. A top Iranian security official claimed the war has “wrecked” the United States, while U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Iran is “bleeding economically." Iran on Tuesday also denied it played a role in a cyberattack that affected supermarket refrigerators in France. And Iranian state TV says two tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Overnight strikes in Yemen kill at least 1 person and injure 9, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Overnight strikes in Yemen have hit a gas station and an oil facility, killing at least one person and injuring nine others. Residents and Houthi rebels reported the attacks on Tuesday. The strikes caused extensive damage and panic in Sanaa, the capital. The Houthi-run health ministry blames Saudi Arabia for the attacks, but the claims are unverified. The strikes come amid renewed fighting between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces. Meanwhile, in Iran, a top security official claimed the war has "wrecked" the United States. He urged Washington to accept Tehran's demands to end the conflict.

articles.title: Republican congressman launches impeachment procedure against US defence chief Hegseth
articles.description: Republican Kentucky Congressman Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, including alleged violations of the 1973 War Powers Resolution, as well as misconduct involving civilian casualties and operations in Yemen and Venezuela.

articles.title: Pete Hegseth impeachment: US lawmaker moves to force House vote over Iran war
articles.description: Republican Thomas Massie moves to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth over military actions in Iran, Yemen and Venezuela as a House vote looms.
